ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45% high-intensity white/light-grey pixels to 55% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white patches are concentrated on the distal lobe tips. The central and medial regions exhibit a dark-pigmented base with a high density of small, circular white pixel clusters and irregular mottling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a sharp central vertex; approximate pixel-measured angle of 42 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular, high-frequency serration pattern along the entire trailing boundary, with peak-to-valley pixel amplitudes ranging from 5 to 15 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep originating from the median notch, transitioning to a convex curvature towards the distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense distribution of high-contrast circular pixel rings (white periphery with dark centers) across approximately 60% of the visible surface area.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several discrete, unaligned white linear pixel streaks are visible, primarily on the left lobe, cutting across the dark primary pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible calcified clusters (barnacles) attached directly to the trailing edge and distal tips, creating high-relief textural irregularities and localized shadows.
other_distinctive_markers: The high density of circular rosette scarring creates a unique high-frequency texture pattern over the entire fluke surface.
